title: Divblox MCP
shortDescription: Turn ideas into delivered work with your AI assistant.
description: Connect your AI assistant to Divblox to shape requirements, create and estimate tickets, plan work, and track delivery—all in the projects you choose. Choose permissions separately for each project; Divblox access rules still apply.
reviewerCredentials: Provided privately to reviewers; never included in this package.
limitations: Windows, Linux desktop and mobile clients are not certified.
History contains recorded events only; incomplete search results must not be treated as complete.
publicationGates: Owner approval of final public branding and messaging
Verified public browser/client access and OAuth onboarding
Publisher verification and reviewer access before directory submissions
